description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints plan to activate RB Travis Etienne Jr. from injured reserve on Saturday.
items.impact: Etienne is in line to make his return for Sunday's game against the Panthers. He should return to his lead role in the Saints backfield.
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to be activated from IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Emmett Johnson will lead Kansas City's rushing attack Sunday against the Falcons.
items.impact: Kenneth Walker is being held out due to a groin injury. Johnson has shown flashes this season backing up Walker and now gets his chance to step into the lead role.
items.title: Emmett Johnson to lead Chiefs backfield Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest between the Kansas City Chiefs and Atlanta Falcons according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Walker III will sit out after suffering a groin injury during Thursday's practice session for head coach Andy Reid, with Emmett Johnson in line for a sizeable increase in touches as the No. 1 option out of the Kansas City backfield against the Falcons Sunday.
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out Sunday
